headline: Prologis (PLD) Stock Slips After Q3 Earnings Expose Dilution Risk
summary: Prologis came into this Q3 2026 report with a premium story and a premium multiple, and the last week has not been kind to that confidence. The stock has drifted lower, slipping about 3% over seven days and roughly 16% over three months, and it dropped another 0.9% on the day after earnings. The headline result did not signal a disaster.
